problem_title: Recurring Construction Of Roadside Drains — Hoodi (2020–2022)
problem_summary: 6 citizen complaints about 'Construction Of Roadside Drains' were recorded in Hoodi between May 2020 and May 2022, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 83% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 6 of 6 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.48). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.83, complaint_volume=0.20.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Hoodi' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Hoodi for the period 2020–2022.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
